Good — `DefaultTransportRateLimitService` implements `TransportRateLimitService`, not `RateLimitService`. It's not relevant here.

Here is the complete picture:

---

**AuthController** directly depends on these service interfaces (declared as fields), with their concrete implementations:

| # | Interface | Concrete Implementation |
|---|-----------|------------------------|
| 1 | `MailService` | `DefaultMailService` |
| 2 | `SystemSecurityService` | `DefaultSystemSecurityService` |
| 3 | `SecuritySettingsService` | `DefaultSecuritySettingsService` |
| 4 | `RateLimitService` | `DefaultRateLimitService` |
| 5 | `TwoFactorAuthService` | `DefaultTwoFactorAuthService` |

> **Non-interface dependencies** (concrete classes injected directly, no interface layer):
> - `BCryptPasswordEncoder` (Spring Security — external)
> - `JwtTokenFactory` (concrete class, no interface)
> - `ApplicationEventPublisher` (Spring — external)
> - `RestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandler` (concrete class, no interface)
